sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Critical Assault (increases Ability Power when performing critical hits) buff limit by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 40% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Water and Wind Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Magnanimous Goddess] Aphrodite or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
